id./param/scenario/cs/b_150_cs_030.pack|cs_: "...Hey, whoever you are, come out. I know you're hiding there.
"W-What is that!?
"Hm, I see... So you're the one, brother...
"I'm one of the Watchers.
"...Watchers? What's that?
"I see, surface folk don't know. Watchers are sky dwellers who've watched over Erdrea since its creation.
"...Really? But what's such an important being doing in a place like this?
"This area used to be the village where the Watchers lived.
"But Mordegon's army attacked, and most of the floating islands fell to the ground. ...I'm the last Watcher left.
"Such a thing... That must have been hard.
"Mordegon's outrageous. ...Sorry for doubting you earlier. I didn't think of your feelings.
"But why were you saved? This place seems unharmed.
"Deep in this Temple of the Sun is a sacred flame, the Guiding Light, burning since the world began.
"When the village was attacked, I happened to be cleaning the temple and was saved by the Guiding Light's protection.
"The Guiding Light's protection? Could it be...?
"We came to this sky land seeking power to dispel Mordegon's darkness. If you know anything, please tell us.
"Hmm, power to beat Mordegon? The Guiding Light isn't a weapon, so what could it mean...?
"I'd like to help, but I'm still a child and don't know about such things.
"Well, if you don't know, it can't be helped. Having come this far, let's first look into that Guiding Light.
"Yes... But as it is...
"Oh, don't worry about me. I'm a Watcher for a reason.
"And when Mordegon is beaten and the Tree revives, the great flow of life will return...
"Then those who died will someday be born again as new life. My family and friends will be saved too.
"...So I'm counting on you, Luminary brother.
